ten_goi.chu: Sepharial applied the name Lilith from medieval Jewish legend, where she is described as the first wife of Adam.

moc.chu: Based on medieval Jewish folklore, Lilith is said to have fled from the Garden of Eden because she did not want to submit to Adam.
He then created a woman for Adam, from the earth, as He had created Adam himself, and called her Lilith.
Lilith responded, "We are equal to each other inasmuch as we were both created from the earth."
When Lilith saw this, she pronounced the Ineffable Name and flew away into the air.
At once, the Holy One, blessed be He, sent these three angels Senoy, Sansenoy, and Semangelof, to bring her back.
They told her God's word, but she did not wish to return.
